metadata.description: Sound effects made in code: a skill that turns a short description into a finished, measured sound, and one that adds new recipe families.

plugins.name: sfx-generator
plugins.description: make-sound-effect (description -> variants, audition page, preset, WAV/OGG/MP3) and create-sound-recipe (add a recipe family). Deterministic numpy recipes. Apache 2.0: free to use anywhere, and you own what you generate.
